captures.title: Full-suite baseline
captures.expectation: A default player in a flat daytime world before Quick Skin applies a custom appearance.

captures.title: Local skin applied
captures.expectation: The centered third-person player wears the custom skin: brown hair, a dark navy plaid jacket and blue trousers.

captures.title: Skin menu
captures.expectation: The Quick Skin player-skin menu is open with its custom panels and controls.

captures.title: External skin imported
captures.expectation: The skin menu shows the externally dropped skin as an available catalog entry without a broken texture.

captures.title: Slim model
captures.expectation: The custom navy-plaid skin is rendered on the slim Alex-style arm model.

captures.title: Classic model
captures.expectation: The custom navy-plaid skin is rendered on the wider classic Steve-style arm model.

captures.title: Cape menu
captures.expectation: The Quick Skin cape menu is open with its custom panels and controls.

captures.title: Bundled cape applied
captures.expectation: The player is seen from behind wearing the bundled orange or gold cape over the custom skin.

captures.title: Cape editor
captures.expectation: The Quick Skin cape-adjustment editor is open with a cape image, grid and editing controls.

captures.title: Cape preview A
captures.expectation: The cape editor previews the first selected cape while keeping the currently worn cape state distinct.

captures.title: Cape preview B
captures.expectation: The cape editor visibly previews the second selected cape, different from preview A.

captures.title: Cape transparency enabled
captures.expectation: The cape editor displays the transparent form of the test cape with the opaque toggle disabled.

captures.title: Cape forced opaque
captures.expectation: The cape editor displays the opaque form of the test cape with the opaque toggle enabled.

captures.title: Cape zoomed out
captures.expectation: The cape editor preview shows the cape at the low zoom position.

captures.title: Cape zoomed in
captures.expectation: The cape editor preview shows a visibly different crop at the high zoom position.

captures.title: Animated cape frame A
captures.expectation: The player wears a real light animated cape with a red circular motif; the surface is not blank, black or garbled.

captures.title: Animated cape frame B
captures.expectation: A later frame of the same light cape is visible and the red motif has moved or changed from frame A.

captures.title: HD cape preserved
captures.expectation: The player wears a crisp custom HD cape with a bright magenta front panel and teal base or trim.

captures.title: Elytra hides cape
captures.expectation: The centered player has angled elytra wings and no flat rectangular cape hanging behind the main body.

captures.title: Editor preview ignores equipped elytra
captures.expectation: The cape editor continues to render its cape preview even while the player has an elytra equipped.

captures.title: Settings screen
captures.expectation: The Quick Skin settings screen is open with readable toggles or checkboxes.

captures.title: Rename dialog
captures.expectation: A compact rename dialog is open with a text input and confirmation control.

captures.title: Delete confirmation
captures.expectation: A compact delete-confirmation dialog is open with cancel and delete controls.

captures.title: HUD player preview
captures.expectation: An in-world view includes a small, distinct player-preview thumbnail in a lower corner.

captures.title: Title-screen layer order
captures.expectation: On the Minecraft title screen, the enlarged 3D player preview occludes the yellow splash text instead of the text crossing the model.

captures.title: Smoke baseline
captures.expectation: A normal first-person flat-world view before the local skin is applied.

captures.title: Smoke local skin
captures.expectation: A normal first-person world view whose small HUD preview shows the brown-haired, navy-plaid custom skin.

captures.title: Propagation subject baseline
captures.expectation: The subject starts in a normal first-person flat-world view with the default appearance.

captures.title: Propagation subject applied
captures.expectation: The subject remains in first person while the lower-corner HUD preview shows the custom navy-plaid appearance.

captures.title: Propagation observer baseline
captures.expectation: The observer starts in a normal first-person world view before inspecting the subject.

captures.title: Propagation observed remotely
captures.expectation: The observer sees Alice wearing the custom navy-plaid skin and the orange or green face of a deep-blue cape.

captures.title: Live subject baseline
captures.expectation: The subject starts in a normal first-person flat-world view with the default appearance.

captures.title: Live subject applied
captures.expectation: The subject's first-person view includes a lower-corner preview of the newly applied custom navy-plaid appearance.

captures.title: Live observer baseline
captures.expectation: The observer starts in a normal first-person world view after joining.

captures.title: Live observer before
captures.expectation: The observer sees Alice with a plain default skin and no cape before the live change.

captures.title: Live observer after
captures.expectation: The observer sees the same Alice changed to the brown-haired navy-plaid skin with a custom orange or green cape.
